reviewer: Claude Fable 5.2 (claude-fable-5-2), the project's AI coordinator. Assistant-assisted review by the same coordinator that maintains the repository; not independent, not human review, not attorney review.
method: Read every raw answer in full against its rubric and the supplied fixtures. For the with-skills answers, searched each quotation and each named authority in that trial's own prompt to see whether it came from the supplied material. One pass, one reviewer, no second grader.
limitations: Not a controlled comparison. Each trial ran in a Claude Code desktop Workflow subagent that had tools (it used Read and Write only, per the harness records) and carried this session's standing context; one baseline answer (W05) repeats a rule from the maintainer's session memory, so the baseline is not a clean no-skill condition. Two answers (I04 with skills, X02 baseline) were given as chat text and copied from the agent transcripts by the coordinator. One model (claude-sonnet-5-5), one run per trial. The two baseline failures are judgment calls a second grader could decide differently. The suite uses supplied synthetic text and does not test retrieval, live law, or skill discovery.
